entries.title: Make a built-in runbook yours
entries.body: Ask your first mate to copy a built-in runbook into your personal workspace, then edit its guidance there. The copy starts off. Turning it on turns the built-in off with one Activity line naming both. Our original stays available: turn your copy off and ours back on to restore it. Your copy stays yours across app updates.
entries.noPicture: The change makes guidance files editable in your personal workspace; copies use the existing runbook switches without changing their appearance.
